body:
CI-RS CLI/P9/pins caller routine readback — bounded independent holder authorization.

Root read the independent plan a434054d195e3101f43c762f975df3f77daeda8cc073b2db64941eb2dfcff8a6, finite routine addendum be9ae5460466cb9ae348623dd1911b870150982a11669696e4a6fa0e484cf3a2, all 33 parser rows in 50ada39aae1e104088cbd1192ac32a9620ae9ebce4a6f96536a10611f9ffcce8 and separate pins input proposal af7be77342bf366f7eaf6b8b60ded94c71659242ae352554bfabe490677b8e32. All eight manifest records and 24 exact input bindings were independently verified. Accepted contracts, original routine v2 and historical review subjects remain unchanged. Root review SHA256 49cfad42280e71a7d8128df012810647791baa052beed5be36e8fd6a8274e8ef.

The ordinary RunSupplyCLI composition reuses existing SupplyDependencies and engines. Explicit candidate/consumers/pins mode arguments retain their existing forms. The closed private P9 route is one leading version followed by exactly one --consumers file and --revision captured-P5-40hex pair in either named order. It reads module/program bytes from that revision, constructs the existing full consumer manifest and does not reread later HEAD as its subject. Historical publish-version.sh retains its human output, prior public arguments plus --consumers, all P1-P8 predicates and zero-write behavior; P9 remains mandatory with --skip-pack. No public --revision is added to the historical script. Default canonical tracked reference program and strict declaration follow the reviewed plan.

Compiled CLI and wrappers transport actual exit 0/1/2/3, exactly one schema JSON, and no build output on stdout. Publisher wrapper excludes foreign modes/private P9; pins wrapper accepts only --manifest plus optional --final-main and supplies its own mode. Bootstrap missing tools, output-directory failure or nonzero build => NOT_EXECUTED/HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE/3; actual build deadline => NOT_EXECUTED/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED/3. Bootstrap report uses existing phase plan for publisher and pins for pins wrapper, dry_run=true, stage NONE, null unestablished identities/census, empty snapshots/effects, and one existing input check. It does not claim an unparsed requested phase. Explicit wrapper route violations are usage errors. Build uses existing 600-second Go budget, a finite five-second kill grace, GOWORK=off, -mod=readonly and owned external temporary output, preserving caller cwd/relative paths and actual child status after cleanup. Missing or malformed P9 child output is unasked, never success. Declaration missing/unread => NOT_EXECUTED/SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; malformed/duplicate/unknown/wrong-type => RED/CONSUMER_DECLARATION_INVALID; empty consumers or zero target imports => RED/CONSUMER_CENSUS_EMPTY.

D8 executable_closure continues to bind tracked sources at F. The actual compiled binary is additionally bound as raw binary FileRef in independently reviewed producer machine/regression ProofSubject.runs.outputs, alongside actual build command/cwd/runtime/F and execution captures. Root verifies and directly executes that same owned frozen artifact before each later live invocation; a shell rebuild or changed artifact requires new proof/review/authorization. This representation uses existing schema, does not claim producerIdentity self-authenticates os.Executable, and grants no current live authority.

Pins CI input construction is accepted as a caller binding: actual Kacho checkout SHA plus one freshly observed canonical Kaname main SHA materialized exactly in an owned Git tree. Retain both observations, complete tracked go.mod census and strict reviewed corelib/kaname mapping; then invoke the existing pins engine with --final-main. A moving main cannot replace the captured subject. This checks the invocation's stated product revisions; final T7 still requires actual delivered consumer revisions. The future implementation scope is the reviewed mapping JSON and named existing ci.yaml step, preserving triggers, permissions and protection. Holder must execute the actual parsed step in both event contexts, including refusal/restored pairs; YAML text matching alone is not execution proof.

Authorize /root/truth_tests to write additive internal/release/supply_cli_test.go, supply_p9_caller_test.go, internal_pins_caller_test.go and scripts/release/release-callers-inject.sh. A narrow fixture-only successor of publish-version-inject.sh may materialize canonical owned repositories/program/declaration and use the previously accepted native Git transport boundary. All 18 original assertion bodies and the exact only-G P6 inversion remain unchanged. Existing engines, independent engine holders and product source remain closed. The later P8 helper extraction/canonical-program read requires its separately reviewed narrow source transition. Actual prerequisites must be executed and frozen; missing future API is CAPABILITY_ABSENT with zero SUT calls, not fabricated semantic RED. No current source edit, product GREEN, D8 execution, release, main or closure is authorized by this test-only event.
